newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota minivan orders exceed sales target.
newsitem.headline: Toyota minivan orders exceed sales target.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday it had received 36,000 orders for its new TownAce Noah and LiteAce Noah recreational vehicles in the month after their launch in Japan.
Toyota launched the two models on October 23 with a total monthly sales target of 6,500 units.
Toyota's 33.4 percent owned Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd makes the TownAce Noah and LiteAce Noah.
Daihatsu's Ikeda plant in Osaka, western Japan, will operate for six extra days in December to keep up with orders, a Toyota spokesman said.
